critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1051 lines. Consider splitting: auth/lockout, codes/access, settings/urls, session WS, HR WS, audit logs, 2FA into modules under /app/backend/app/ for maintainability.

Cookie SameSite=lax is honored by the backend, but the external preview ingress (Cloudflare __cf_bm) rewrites Set-Cookie to include Partitioned; SameSite=none. This is out-of-scope for backend but note: for TRUE cross-site guest overlays (embedded on other origins) the rewrite is what actually reaches the browser. For same-origin preview it's fine.

The review request references dashboard testids 'device-host, live-session, recent-activity, base-urls, safety-limits' but the actual DOM uses '-card' suffix (base-urls-card, safety-limits-card, activity-log-card) and 'live-queue' + 'connect-device-button'. Naming is fine but the review request naming is stale; not a bug.

check_lockout runs BEFORE any code validity check on /api/access, so once locked even a legit guest with a valid code gets 429. Documented intentionally; the docstring in review confirms this. UX note: guests would see a 429 with no path to recovery except waiting 15min or admin clearing login_attempts.
